_doc: Allowed levers for the nightly experiment loop (experiment_loop.py). ONLY these levers and values can ever be applied (main.apply_loop / arm_for). Order = test queue. pacing 'fast' and length 'short' were checked 2026-10-16 for seed acceptance (cup 1.25% / 4.3%, royale 20% / 19% of seeds - enough inside the director's 300-400 tries). 2026-11-12: 'short' is now a 12-15 s video (10.5-13.5 s match, ~0.6% of cup seeds, the director searches 1200) that loops into its first frame; moved ahead of standings. Length is judged on views@72h: a shorter video gets a higher % watched for free.

levers.hypothesis: A 16-country royale heat gives a 91%-UK audience a stake (find your country), raising avg % watched over a 1-v-1 cup match.

variants: Pick a country before it starts!
levers.hypothesis: Asking viewers to commit to a country before the first ring breaks makes them stay to see it through, raising avg % watched.
A first ring inside ~1s and no lull over 4.5s (vs 2s / 6s) removes the early dead moments where viewers swipe.
12-15 s matches whose end dissolves back into the first frame get watched through and replayed (views track % watched, r=0.7 in Nov), which TikTok rewards with more views.
A visible titles table and an 'N wins from the trophy' line give each cup match a stake, raising avg % watched (review 2026-11-09).
